faqs.q: What is SMC TIU series polyurethane tubing used for?
faqs.a: SMC TIU tubing (part numbers starting TIUB) is flexible inch-size polyurethane tube for general compressed-air and water lines on valves, cylinders and machines. The maker lists it as kink, cut, tear and abrasion resistant at Shore A 95, and this listing carries 256 part numbers from 1/8" to 1/2" OD in standard and extended colours.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC TIUB part number such as TIUB07BU-20?
faqs.a: TIUB07BU-20 reads as series TIUB (inch polyurethane), size 07 (1/4" OD), colour BU (blue) and length code 20, a 20 m roll. Size codes are 01 (1/8"), 05 (3/16"), 07 (1/4"), 11 (3/8") and 13 (1/2"); length codes include 33 (33 m, 100 ft), 153 (153 m, 500 ft) and 305 (305 m, 1,000 ft). Anything after the length code, such as -X108, marks a special version.

faqs.q: What OD and ID sizes does SMC TIU polyurethane tubing come in?
faqs.a: SMC makes TIUB tube in five inch sizes, OD x ID: 1/8" (3.18 x 2 mm), 3/16" (4.76 x 3.18 mm), 1/4" (6.35 x 4.23 mm), 3/8" (9.53 x 6.35 mm) and 1/2" (12.7 x 8.46 mm). Pick the OD to suit the push-in fitting and the ID for flow. Metric TU equivalents are on the [SMC Tubings listing](/p/smc-tubings).

faqs.q: What do the SMC TIUB colour codes BU2, G3 and YR1 mean?
faqs.a: The letters give the colour and the digit the shade, so BU2 is clear blue, G3 neon green and YR1 clear orange. SMC adds 21 extended colours to the standard B, W, R, BU, Y, G, C (clear) and YR (orange), including BR1 brown, GR1 gray, P1 neon pink, PU1 solid purple and S1 silver, which helps colour-code separate circuits.

faqs.q: What is the maximum working pressure of SMC TIU polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: SMC rates TIU/TU polyurethane tubing at 0.8 MPa (8 bar, about 115 psi) maximum working pressure at 20°C, the figure shown on every row of our size table. Pressure falls as temperature rises toward the 60°C limit, so check the maker's curve at your temperature and use the lower rating of tube or fitting.

faqs.q: Can SMC TIU polyurethane tubing carry water as well as compressed air?
faqs.a: Yes. SMC lists TIU tubing for air from -20 to +60°C and for general industrial water from 0 to 40°C without freezing. For any other fluid SMC asks to be consulted first; our [tubing materials guide](/blog/pneumatic-tubing-materials-guide) compares polyurethane with nylon and fluoropolymer for wetter, hotter or chemical duty.

faqs.q: Is SMC TIU polyurethane tubing RoHS compliant?
faqs.a: SMC marks the TU/TIUB polyurethane series RoHS in its tubing catalogue. This listing holds no other compliance documents, so if your project needs a certificate of conformity or a material declaration, say so in the enquiry and we request it from the maker with the order.

faqs.q: Which push-in fittings fit SMC TIU 1/4" and 3/8" polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: SMC TIU tubing fits inch-size One-touch push-in, insert, self-align and miniature fittings of the same nominal OD, so 1/4" tube needs a 1/4" fitting, not a 6 mm one. Inch push-in connectors, unions and silencers are on our [pneumatic fittings and silencers shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: How should SMC TIU polyurethane tubing be cut and inspected?
faqs.a: Cut TIU tube square with a tube cutter, push it fully home into the fitting and keep bends above the maker's minimum bending radius. SMC advises periodic checks for cracks, gouges, wear, leaks, twisting, crushing and hardening, and replacing damaged tube rather than repairing or patching it.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC TIU and SMC TUZ polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: TIU is SMC's standard flexible polyurethane tube in inch sizes, while [SMC TUZ](/p/smc-tuz-series-wear-resistant-tubing) is a metric special-polyurethane tube that SMC tests at about one third of the abrasion of its standard TU tube. Both carry 0.8 MPa at 20°C; choose TUZ where tube rubs in cable carriers or moving machinery.

faqs.q: Where is SMC TIU tubing shipped from and which HS code applies?
faqs.a: We ship SMC TIU tubing from our Dubai warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. Plastic tube without fittings normally falls under HS subheading 3917.32; the country of origin depends on the SMC plant that made the roll and is stated on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you keep SMC TIU polyurethane tubing in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep SMC TIU series polyurethane tubing in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the TIUB part numbers, colours and roll quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What does the SMC Tubings listing cover?
faqs.a: SMC Tubings is a short list of 10 popular SMC polyurethane air and water rolls: inch TIUB tube in 1/4", 3/8" and 1/2" OD and metric TU tube in 6, 8 and 10 mm OD. The maker lists it as kink, cut, tear, chemical and abrasion resistant for general-purpose air/water; the full inch range is on [SMC TIU series](/p/smc-tiu-series-polyurethane-tubing).

faqs.q: How do you read SMC TU part numbers such as TU0604BU-20 and TU1065C-100?
faqs.a: TU0604BU-20 is SMC TU polyurethane tube, 6 mm OD x 4 mm ID, blue, on a 20 m roll, and TU1065C-100 is 10 mm OD x 6.5 mm ID, clear, on a 100 m roll. The first two digits give the OD and the next two the ID in mm (65 means 6.5), followed by the colour code and the roll length.

faqs.q: Which metric sizes of SMC TU tubing are on the SMC Tubings listing?
faqs.a: This listing carries TU0604 (6 x 4 mm) in blue or clear, TU0805 (8 x 5 mm) in black and TU1065 (10 x 6.5 mm) in clear or clear blue, on 20 m and 100 m rolls. SMC also makes TU0425 (4 x 2.5 mm) and TU1208 (12 x 8 mm) in the same series; ask for them if your fittings need those sizes.

faqs.q: Which inch sizes of SMC TIUB tubing are on the SMC Tubings listing?
faqs.a: The listing has TIUB07 (1/4", 6.35 x 4.23 mm), TIUB11 (3/8", 9.53 x 6.35 mm) and TIUB13 (1/2", 12.7 x 8.46 mm) in black, blue or clear, on 33 m (100 ft) and 153 m (500 ft) rolls. Use inch tube with inch fittings: 1/4" tube is not a substitute for 6 mm tube in a metric push-in fitting.

faqs.q: What pressure are SMC TU and TIUB polyurethane tubes rated for?
faqs.a: SMC rates TU and TIUB polyurethane tubing at 0.8 MPa (8 bar, about 115 psi) maximum working pressure at 20°C, and every roll on this listing shows that 8 bar figure. It falls as temperature rises toward 60°C, so check the maker's burst-pressure curve and use the lower rating of tube or fitting.

faqs.q: Is SMC TU polyurethane tubing suitable for water lines?
faqs.a: Yes, for general industrial water from 0 to 40°C without freezing; with air SMC allows -20 to +60°C. SMC asks to be consulted for other fluids, and our [tubing materials guide](/blog/pneumatic-tubing-materials-guide) explains when nylon or fluoropolymer suits a line better than polyurethane.

faqs.q: Do SMC TU and TIUB polyurethane tubes meet RoHS?
faqs.a: Yes, SMC marks the TU/TIUB polyurethane series RoHS in its catalogue. We hold no further compliance papers on this listing; name any certificate of conformity or declaration you need when you order and we request it from SMC.

faqs.q: Which fittings suit SMC TU 6 mm, 8 mm and 10 mm polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: Use metric One-touch push-in, insert, self-align or miniature fittings matched to the tube OD: 6 mm for TU0604, 8 mm for TU0805 and 10 mm for TU1065. Push-in connectors, unions and silencers are on our [pneumatic fittings shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: How do you fit SMC polyurethane tubing into a push-in fitting without leaks?
faqs.a: Cut the TU or TIUB tube square, check the end is round and free of burrs, push it past the release collet until it bottoms, then pull back to confirm it is held. SMC warns that surge pressure above the maximum operating pressure can damage fittings and tube, so size the line for peak, not average, pressure.

faqs.q: What is the difference between clear and coloured SMC TU tubing?
faqs.a: Clear (C) SMC TU and TIUB tube lets you see water or dirt moving in the line, while blue (BU) and black (B) are used to colour-code supply, exhaust or separate circuits. The polyurethane and SMC's 0.8 MPa rating at 20°C are the same across the listed colours.

faqs.q: Where are SMC TU and TIUB tubes shipped from, and under which HS code?
faqs.a: We dispatch SMC TU and TIUB rolls from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa, Asia and further afield. Plastic tube without fittings normally falls under HS subheading 3917.32, and the country of origin of each roll is shown on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Can I buy SMC TU and TIUB polyurethane tubing ex-stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We hold these SMC TU and TIUB polyurethane rolls in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send part numbers and roll quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a price.

faqs.q: What is SMC TUZ series wear-resistant tubing?
faqs.a: SMC TUZ is a metric special-polyurethane tube built for lines that rub, flex or run in cable carriers, with abrasion SMC measures at about one third of its standard TU tube. It carries air or water, and this listing holds 23 part numbers in 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 mm OD.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC TUZ part number such as TUZ0604BU-20?
faqs.a: TUZ0604BU-20 is TUZ wear-resistant tube, 6 mm OD x 4 mm ID, blue (BU), on a 20 m roll. The four digits give OD then ID in mm, the letters the colour (B, W, R, BU, Y, G) and the last number the roll length: 20 for a 20 m roll, 100 for a 100 m roll.

faqs.q: What sizes does SMC TUZ wear-resistant tubing come in?
faqs.a: SMC lists TUZ in OD x ID 2 x 1.2, 3.2 x 2, 4 x 2.5, 6 x 4, 8 x 5, 10 x 6.5, 12 x 8 and 16 x 10 mm. This listing stocks TUZ0425, TUZ0604, TUZ0805, TUZ1065 and TUZ1208, the 4 to 12 mm sizes, in six colours.

faqs.q: How much more abrasion resistant is SMC TUZ than standard polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: In SMC's own test, TUZ lost a maximum of 0.16 mm against 0.46 mm for its TU polyurethane tube after 10 million cycles, roughly one third of the wear. That figure comes from SMC's specific test conditions, so treat it as a comparison rather than a service-life guarantee.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of SMC TUZ tubing at 20°C and 60°C?
faqs.a: SMC rates TUZ at 0.8 MPa (8 bar, about 115 psi) maximum working pressure at 20°C, the figure on every row of our size table, falling to 0.4 MPa at 60°C, its upper temperature limit. Use the lower rating of tube or fitting, and allow for the drop on warm machines.

faqs.q: Can SMC TUZ tubing be used with water?
faqs.a: Yes. SMC lists TUZ for air from -20 to +60°C and for general industrial water from 0 to 40°C, with no freezing. For other fluids, consult the maker; the material is a special polyurethane, so the chemical limits of polyurethane still apply.

faqs.q: Is SMC TUZ tubing RoHS compliant?
faqs.a: SMC marks the TUZ series RoHS in its catalogue. We hold no other compliance documents on this listing; if you need a declaration of conformity or material statement with the delivery, state it with the order.

faqs.q: Which fittings does SMC recommend for TUZ wear-resistant tubing?
faqs.a: SMC lists KQ2 One-touch fittings, KF insert fittings, KFG2 stainless steel 316 insert fittings and M/MS miniature hose-nipple fittings for TUZ. Matching metric push-in connectors are on our [pneumatic fittings and silencers shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: How should SMC TUZ tubing be routed in a cable carrier?
faqs.a: Allow extra tube length on moving parts, and follow the bending radius the cable-carrier or protection-tube maker recommends rather than the static minimum. Inspect TUZ periodically for cuts, wear, crushing or hardening and replace any damaged length; SMC does not allow patched tube to be reused.

faqs.q: When should I choose SMC TUZ instead of SMC TUH polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: Choose TUZ when the tube moves or rubs and may carry water; choose [SMC TUH hard polyurethane](/p/smc-tuh-series-polyurethane-tubing) for static air-only lines where a stiffer tube and up to 1.0 MPa matter. TUH is ester polyurethane, which SMC does not allow with water.

faqs.q: Where do you ship SMC TUZ wear-resistant tubing from, and what HS code does it carry?
faqs.a: We ship SMC TUZ from our Dubai, UAE warehouse worldwide. Plastic tube without fittings is normally classed under HS subheading 3917.32; the origin of each roll is printed on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Is SMC TUZ wear-resistant tubing available from stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep SMC TUZ wear-resistant tubing in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send sizes, colours and roll lengths through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is SMC TUH series hard polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: SMC TUH is a stiffer hard-polyurethane air tube made in two types: a standard type rated 0.8 MPa and a high-pressure type rated 1.0 MPa at 20°C. It is for compressed air only, and this listing holds 26 part numbers from 4 to 12 mm OD.

faqs.q: How do you tell SMC TUH standard and high-pressure types apart by part number?
faqs.a: The size code shows the type: TUH0428, TUH0644, TUH0858, TUH1073 and TUH1288 are the thinner-wall standard type, while TUH0425, TUH0604, TUH0805, TUH1065 and TUH1208 are the thicker-wall high-pressure type. For example, TUH0644 is 6 x 4.4 mm and TUH0604 is 6 x 4 mm.

faqs.q: What sizes does SMC TUH hard polyurethane tubing come in?
faqs.a: Standard type OD x ID: 4 x 2.8, 6 x 4.4, 8 x 5.8, 10 x 7.3 and 12 x 8.8 mm. High-pressure type: 4 x 2.5, 6 x 4, 8 x 5, 10 x 6.5 and 12 x 8 mm. Colours are black (B), white (W), blue (BU) and translucent (N), on 20 m (-20) or 100 m (-100) rolls.

faqs.q: What is the maximum working pressure of SMC TUH tubing?
faqs.a: SMC rates the TUH standard type at 0.8 MPa (8 bar) and the high-pressure type at 1.0 MPa (10 bar) maximum working pressure at 20°C, as shown row by row on our size table. Limits are lower at higher temperature per SMC's burst-pressure curve, up to the 60°C maximum.

faqs.q: Can SMC TUH polyurethane tubing be used for water?
faqs.a: No. SMC states TUH is ester polyurethane, so water cannot be used because it causes hydrolysis; TUH is for air only, from -20 to 60°C. For air-and-water lines use [SMC TUZ](/p/smc-tuz-series-wear-resistant-tubing) or standard TU polyurethane instead.

faqs.q: Is SMC TUH tubing RoHS compliant?
faqs.a: SMC marks the TUH series RoHS in its catalogue. If your QA process needs a written declaration or certificate of conformity for the TUH rolls, ask with your enquiry and we will obtain it from the maker.

faqs.q: Which fittings work with SMC TUH hard polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: SMC lists One-touch fittings for the TUH standard type, and One-touch, insert, self-align and miniature fittings for the high-pressure type. Match the fitting to the tube OD in mm; metric push-in fittings are on our [pneumatic fittings shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: What should I check when installing SMC TUH tubing?
faqs.a: Keep TUH bends above the minimum bending radius, cut square, and use a fitting whose pressure rating is at least that of the tube, since SMC says to work to the lower of the two. Avoid sudden adiabatic compression heating and inspect for cracking or hardening, replacing tube rather than patching it.

faqs.q: Where is SMC TUH hard polyurethane tubing typically used?
faqs.a: SMC TUH suits static compressed-air piping on machines and panels where a stiffer tube holds its route and the high-pressure type gives 1.0 MPa at 20°C. It is not for water, and moving or rubbing lines are better served by a wear-resistant tube.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC TUH and SMC TIU polyurethane tubing?
faqs.a: TUH is a metric hard polyurethane for air only, rated up to 1.0 MPa, while [SMC TIU](/p/smc-tiu-series-polyurethane-tubing) is a softer inch-size polyurethane rated 0.8 MPa that also takes water. Pick TUH for stiffer, higher-pressure air runs and TIU or TU where flexibility and water service matter.

faqs.q: What is SMC TCU series coil tubing?

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC TCU coil tube part number such as TCU0604B-1-23-X6?
faqs.a: TCU0604B-1-23-X6 is TCU coil tube 6 x 4 mm, black (B), 1 core, with 23 coil windings, and -X6 marks the made-to-order coil-turn option. The core count can be 1, 2 or 3 tubes in parallel, so TCU0604B-3-16-X6 is a three-core 6 mm coil with 16 windings.

faqs.q: What sizes and core counts does SMC TCU coil tubing come in?
faqs.a: SMC makes TCU in 4 x 2.5, 6 x 4, 8 x 5, 10 x 6.5 and 12 x 8 mm, with 1, 2 or 3 cores depending on size. This listing holds 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 mm coils, including 6 mm black, blue and white and 8 mm black, blue, green and red.

faqs.q: How do I choose the number of coil windings for SMC TCU tubing?
faqs.a: More windings give a longer maximum stretched length, so pick N from the reach the tool needs, adding margin so the coil is never pulled straight. SMC publishes the maximum operating length per winding count for each size; send us the required stretch and size and we will confirm the TCU code.

faqs.q: What is the maximum working pressure of SMC TCU coil tubing?
faqs.a: SMC rates TCU coil tubing at 0.8 MPa (8 bar, about 115 psi) maximum working pressure at 20°C for air, the figure shown for every coil on this listing. The operating range is -20 to +60°C and capacity drops as temperature rises, so use the lower rating of tube or fitting.

faqs.q: What fluids can SMC TCU coil tubing carry?
faqs.a: SMC lists TCU for compressed air and asks to be consulted for any other fluid. For water lines choose a straight polyurethane tube rated for water instead; our [tubing materials guide](/blog/pneumatic-tubing-materials-guide) compares the options.

faqs.q: Which fittings connect SMC TCU coil tubing?
faqs.a: TCU coils accept SMC One-touch push-in, insert, self-align and miniature fittings in the same metric OD, fitted on the straight tails at each end. Matching connectors are on our [pneumatic fittings and silencers shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: Can SMC TCU coil tubing be cut to length?
faqs.a: No. SMC warns not to cut the coil and push it into a fitting, because the coiled section may leak or pull out after installation. Order the winding count you need and connect only through the straight tails.

faqs.q: Where is SMC TCU polyurethane coil tubing used?
faqs.a: TCU coil tube feeds air to tools and devices that move toward and away from the supply, such as hand tools, spray guns, robot heads and test fixtures, keeping slack off the floor. Multi-core versions run two or three lines, for example supply and exhaust, in one coil.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC TCU coil tubing and straight SMC TU tubing?
faqs.a: TCU is pre-coiled polyurethane that extends and recoils, ordered by winding count, while straight TU on [SMC Tubings](/p/smc-tubings) is sold by the roll and cut to length. TCU is for air only; straight TU also takes general industrial water.

faqs.q: What is SMC T series nylon tubing used for?

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC T series nylon tube code such as T0425B-20?

faqs.q: What sizes does the SMC T series nylon tubing listing cover?

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC T0425 and T0403, or T0604 and T0645?
faqs.a: They share the OD but differ in wall: T0425 (4 x 2.5 mm) and T0604 (6 x 4 mm) are thick-wall and rated 3.3 and 3.0 MPa at 20°C, while T0403 (4 x 3 mm) and T0645 (6 x 4.5 mm) are thin-wall at 2.0 MPa with a larger bore. Choose thick wall for pressure, thin wall for flow.

faqs.q: What pressure is SMC T series nylon tubing rated for?
faqs.a: SMC rates T series nylon at 20°C to 3.3 MPa (33 bar) for T0425, 3.0 MPa (30 bar) for T0604 and 2.0 MPa (20 bar) for T0403, T0645 and T0806, as listed on our size table. At 100°C these fall to 1.2, 1.1 and 0.75 MPa, so derate hot lines and use the lower rating of tube or fitting.

faqs.q: Can SMC T series nylon tubing carry water?
faqs.a: Yes. SMC lists T series Nylon 12 tube for air from -40 to +100°C and for general industrial water from 0 to +70°C without freezing. For how nylon compares with polyurethane on flexibility and pressure, see our [tubing materials guide](/blog/pneumatic-tubing-materials-guide).

faqs.q: Is SMC T series nylon tubing RoHS compliant?

faqs.q: Which fittings are used with SMC T series nylon tubing?

faqs.q: What does SMC say about installing T series nylon tubing?

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC T series nylon and SMC TS soft nylon tubing?

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC TS soft nylon part number such as TS0604BU-100-X3?

faqs.q: How do I pick a TS soft nylon size for a push-in fitting?

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature is SMC TS soft nylon tubing rated for?

faqs.q: Can SMC TS soft nylon tubing carry water?

faqs.q: Should I use TISA inch tubing or TS metric tubing with my fittings?

faqs.q: What pressure is SMC TIS soft nylon tubing rated for?

faqs.q: What temperature and fluids suit SMC TIS soft nylon tubing?

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC TIA nylon tube part number such as TIA07B-20?

faqs.q: Which SMC TIA nylon tube size suits a 1/4" push-in fitting?

faqs.q: What is SMC TR series flame-resistant tubing?

This listing holds 126 part numbers across four types: TRS, TRB, TRBU and TRTU, in 6 to 12 mm OD.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC TRS, TRB, TRBU and TRTU tubing?

TRTU adds an aluminium laminated film between its polyurethane and polyolefin layers. TRTU has twice the spatter resistance of TRBU.

faqs.q: What sizes does SMC TR flame-resistant tubing come in?
faqs.a: TRS comes in 4 x 2.5, 6 x 3, 8 x 5, 10 x 6.5 and 12 x 8 mm; TRB in 6 x 4, 8 x 6, 10 x 7.5 and 12 x 9 mm; TRBU and TRTU in 6 x 4, 8 x 5, 10 x 6.5 and 12 x 8 mm inner tube. On double-layer types the size code gives the inner tube, which is what goes into the fitting.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC TR part number such as TRBU0805G-20?
faqs.a: TRBU0805G-20 is TRBU double-layer polyurethane tube, 8 mm OD x 5 mm ID inner tube, green outer layer, 20 m roll; the -100 code is a 100 m reel. The outer colour is chosen by the letter (B, W, R, BU, Y, G), while SMC makes the inner tube of every double-layer type black.

faqs.q: What pressure is SMC TR flame-resistant tubing rated for?

faqs.q: What temperatures and fluids can SMC TR flame-resistant tubing handle?

faqs.q: Does SMC TR flame-resistant tubing meet UL-94 V-0?

faqs.q: Which fittings does SMC recommend for TR flame-resistant tubing?

faqs.q: How do you fit SMC TRB or TRBU double-layer tubing into a push-in fitting?

faqs.q: Where is SMC TR flame-resistant tubing used?

faqs.q: What is SMC TPH series clean-room polyolefin tubing?

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC TPH part number such as TPH0604BU-100?

faqs.q: What sizes does SMC TPH clean-room tubing come in?

faqs.q: Which colours and roll lengths does SMC TPH clean-room tubing come in?

faqs.q: What is the maximum working pressure of SMC TPH polyolefin tubing?

faqs.q: How should SMC TPH tubing be handled for clean-room use?

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC TPH and SMC TPS clean-room tubing?
